title: As Long As I Have Breath

request.style: English, male solo voice, warm and reverent, piano, cello, acoustic guitar, soft strings, organ, solemn and majestic, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Praise the LORD, O my soul
I will praise Him as long as I live
I will sing praise to my God
As long as I have breath in my lungs
Do not put your trust in princes
In mortals who cannot save
When their breath departs from them
They return to the dust below

[Chorus]
Praise the LORD, O my soul
I will praise Him as long as I live
I will sing praise to my God
As long as I have breath in my lungs

[Verse]
On that day all their plans
Come to nothing in the end
Blessed is the one whose help
Is the God of Jacob's name
Whose hope is in the LORD
His God, the living One

[Chorus]
Praise the LORD, O my soul
I will praise Him as long as I live
I will sing praise to my God
As long as I have breath in my lungs

[Outro]
Praise the LORD, O my soul
As long as I have breath
